comment: Every entry is a committed, reviewed platform/profile exclusion. A JUnit skip is tolerated by tools/build_provenance.py only when its skip message exactly equals one of these reasons (and the platform matches), or when the same test passed in a peer required report of the same job. Any new skip reason fails the gate until it is documented here with the gate that really executes it.

exclusions.reason: Certificate processing requires Linux Landlock ABI3+ and libseccomp; covered by dedicated Linux CI
Isolated Linux decoder required; dedicated Linux CI covers this module
Explicit browser acceptance with installed Chromium required
Compose validation runs in the dedicated Docker CI gate
The PostgreSQL legacy upgrade witness is tested separately
SQLite file-copy restore; PostgreSQL restore uses the opt-in native rehearsal
Dedicated native PostgreSQL with host dump/restore coordination required
isolated PostgreSQL shared-counter rehearsal is opt-in
